Cuando el juego crashea se guarda la hue: When the game crashes, the error fingerprint (type of failure and mods involved) is saved and, when an AI fixes it, the lesson. That way, whoever hits the same problem gets it fixed by the AI on the first try.

Los permisos los gestiona tu IA: antes d: Permissions are handled by your AI: before opening the game or changing mods, packs or configs it will ask you, and you can tell it not to ask again. It opens in the game folder with the launcher tools loaded. Try asking «the game crashes, fix it» or «link my resource pack from C:\projects\mypack».
Al cerrar el juego se guarda un resumen: When the game closes, a summary of the session is saved: active mods, what the world is like (dimensions, how it generates, mode, difficulty, rules), what happened (mobs killed, causes of death, minutes) and how it went (loading, lag, errors, crashes). With the fport1-social mod, its per-minute performance measurements (FPS, MSPT, memory, entities) are added and, when the AI changes something, whether the game ran better or worse afterwards. Also what the AI learns when fixing or building something. That way the AI knows how the game behaves with each combination of mods, and whoever hits the same thing gets it solved on the first try.
Conectan cada IA con el launcher (servid: They connect each AI to the launcher (MCP server «modpack-launcher»): launch the game, read crashes, install or change mods and packs, edit configs, see everything that exists in the game, read worlds and create and validate projects.
